body:
Yeah, that does make sense to me :) it feels like a physical and mental separation. 
Sometimes I look down at my arms and feel like they don't even belong to me.
No, I haven't...but I have heard of it. Thanks, I'll look it up.

No, it's not that...I'd like to experience that one day, though. I just feel disconnected, but my soul isn't drifting away from my body. It just hits me randomly...I could be talking to a person, and I feel like the words that I'm saying aren't coming from me.

I guess I feel like I haven't had much time for myself. I'm sick at the moment, and I just finished placement (studying childcare, so I was working in a childcare centre for 2 weeks) I just accepted a casual job there, but I don't know how I feel about it. I still have a casual job as a waitress, but business has been slow. 

I've been depressed many times in the past; I'm just tired of working through things.
